purpose.en: Review the complete feature across production boundaries.
purpose.zh: 审阅跨模块连接后的完整功能。

exit.en: Production wiring, ownership, transitions and recovery have been reviewed.
exit.zh: 生产接线、权威归属、状态转移与恢复已审阅。

failure.en: Send findings to the responsible owner and review affected consumers.
failure.zh: 将问题交给对应负责人，审阅受影响的使用方。

boundary.en: Remove superseded paths; keep one current unpublished development contract.
boundary.zh: 移除已取代路径；未发布开发状态保留一套现行契约。
